import pytest

from f081 import numerical_letter_grade


def test_numerical_letter_grade_all_branches():
    """Each GPA value hits a distinct branch of the if/elif chain."""
    grades = [4.0, 3.8, 3.5, 3.1, 2.9, 2.5, 2.1, 1.9, 1.5, 1.1, 0.9, 0.3, 0.0]
    expected = ["A+", "A", "A-", "B+", "B", "B-", "C+", "C", "C-", "D+", "D", "D-", "E"]
    result = numerical_letter_grade(grades)
    assert result == expected
    assert len(result) == len(grades)


def test_numerical_letter_grade_boundaries():
    """Values exactly on a threshold fall through to the next (lower) grade."""
    grades = [3.7, 3.3, 3.0, 2.7, 2.3, 2.0, 1.7, 1.3, 1.0, 0.7, -0.5]
    expected = ["A-", "B+", "B-", "C+", "C", "C-", "D+", "D", "D-", "E", "E"]

def test_numerical_letter_grade_empty():
    """An empty input yields an empty output list."""
    assert numerical_letter_grade([]) == []


def test_numerical_letter_grade_does_not_mutate_input():
    """The function must not modify the input list (no state pollution)."""
    grades = [4.0, 2.0, 0.0]
    snapshot = list(grades)
    numerical_letter_grade(grades)
    assert grades == snapshot
